runner_wide_discrepancies: Both runners declare the same 37 step names; no step is platform-only.
SH has no DependsOn mechanism at all (affects sca, dependency-lifecycle, semantic-index).

Both runners start containers with default Docker networking: no step is network-isolated, so sca (api.osv.dev), Semgrep registry packs, and checkov/trivy policy downloads could silently use the network.
Both runners address images by mutable local tags (audit-iac:local, audit-container:local, scancode-toolkit:local, and the ImageTag default); none is a digest.
